key.answer_key: The two channels disagree: the PFM phase map (F3e) marks only a few small CIPS patches, while the PFM amplitude map (F3f) of that same area shows an extensive CIPS network (o17). So the phase-map read alone would understate the network the claim describes; only the amplitude channel shows the full extent.
